findings.fonts: No custom font files or declared font stack; selected Outfit and Onest for the redesign, with system fallbacks.
findings.palette: Tailwind CSS 4 import only in src/styles/styles.css; no existing role-based color tokens.
findings.motion: No motion library; existing UI relies on CSS utilities and a timed loading label.
findings.spacing: Tailwind default scale plus arbitrary utility values in component markup.
findings.framework: React 19, Vite 6, React Router 7, TanStack Query 5; app screens are composed through src/App.jsx and src/routes.jsx.

preserve: Existing routes and React component responsibilities.
Weather and saved-city queries, mutations, state, handlers, and displayed facts.
Breeze wordmark asset, weather icons, and Leaflet map integration.
introduce: Ultraviolet night color and type tokens.
Responsive shared app navigation and screen layouts.
Consistent loading, empty, error, selected, and disabled presentations where existing logic supplies those states.
